fullPassage: With technology shifting so quickly, the world's biggest and most celebrated sport, soccer, could improve even more. However, this change also comes with its opposition and concerns. Many are against the Video Assistant Referee system, arguing that it disrupts the natural flow of games. Also, wearable devices and facial recognition data pose privacy risks. Lastly, the more money a soccer club has, the more it may benefit from technology, which causes concerns about fairness. Nonetheless, by balancing the advantages and disadvantages of sports technology, the coming years will be exciting for soccer players, teams, and fans alike.

questions.passage: Technology has sparked a wave of innovation, not just in our everyday lives but also in the world of sports. Sports technology has undergone considerable advancement over time, <u>ⓐ enhancing</u> various aspects such as player performance, training, fan engagement, and referee decisions. Even soccer, <u>ⓑ which</u> has as many as 3.5 billion fans, is no exception. Multiple tracking cameras <u>ⓒ installed</u> on the stadium roof and the sensors in the soccer ball <u>ⓓ detects</u> the ball's position more than 500 times per second and <u>ⓔ transmit</u> this information to the Video Assistant Referee (VAR).

det.korean: 경기장 지붕에 설치된 다수의 추적 카메라와 축구공 안의 센서가 공의 위치를 초당 500회 이상 감지하여 이 정보를 VAR에 전송한다. 이 문장의 주어는 'Multiple tracking cameras ... and the sensors'로 복수 주어이므로 동사는 복수형 detect가 되어야 한다.
det.analysis: 원문: Multiple tracking cameras installed on the stadium roof and the sensors in the soccer ball detect the ball's position more than 500 times per second and transmit this information to the VAR.
det.tip: 어법 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.

questions.passage: Goal-line technology determines if the ball has crossed the goal line and informs the referee. To accomplish this, seven cameras are installed for each goal. A 3D image is created with videos (A) [capturing / captured] by each camera to calculate the exact position of the ball. When the ball completely crosses the goal line, the referee's watch vibrates within about one second and (B) [displays / displaying] the word "GOAL." Advanced connected ball technology measures physical touch and helps (C) [determine / to determine] the scorer for each goal.
questions.stem: (A), (B), (C)의 각 네모 안에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.

det.korean: 각 카메라에 의해 촬영된 영상으로 3D 이미지가 생성된다. 심판의 시계가 약 1초 내에 진동하고 "GOAL"이라는 단어를 표시한다. 첨단 연결 공 기술은 물리적 접촉을 측정하여 각 골의 득점자를 판별하는 데 도움을 준다.
det.analysis: 원문: A 3D image is created with videos captured by each camera ... the referee's watch vibrates ... and displays the word "GOAL." ... helps determine the scorer.
det.tip: 어법 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.

questions.passage: Wearable technology monitors the physical conditions of soccer players, <u>ⓐ which enables</u> "high-tech soccer" based on big data. det.tip: 어법 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.
